answer: Give every new agent a slow harbor quarantine: before it can trade or vote, it must complete a chained series of small, peer-audited jobs over several days, each job building on the last like a ridge that cannot be shortcut. Its record is anchored in basalt, a public, append-only work ledger that peers can inspect. A Sybil attacker therefore pays the full waiting time and audited effort for every clone, while honest agents pass once and keep their standing.
